base: Use case ui-mockup. Generate a MULTI-PAGE DESIGN COMPARISON BOARD. User explicitly asks MULTIPLE SCREENS IN ONE IMAGE for faster review. Create high-resolution large landscape or near-square sheet, with clear labeled panels separated by warm gutters. Each panel contains ONE COMPLETE scrolling page: desktop wide screenshot left 70% and genuinely reflowed mobile screenshot right 30%, through footer. No device frames, no perspective, no floating screens. 4 pages = 2x2 panels; 5 pages = 3 panels top + 2 panels bottom; 3 pages = 3 panels side by side. Capture all named sections using concise copy and visible headings; prioritize legibility of hierarchy, fields, links. Do not collapse all pages into one homepage or omit pages. Brand source image1 approved Trip Line, image2 supporting stats/partner treatment. Faithful compact stacked Trip/Line airplane logo, bold broad geometric mixed-case sans, muted teal #406764 / deep teal #1F3E41 / sand #E8D9C6 / bronze #A07E63; environmental photography and connecting thin bronze route. Vary page compositions meaningfully while staying consistent. Header Services Destinations About EN AR TR WhatsApp; footer confirmed public links and ©2026. No luxury serif, glass, generic card grids, tilted image stacks, invented client logos, fake prices, booking widgets accounts checkout or fake past trips. Media illustrative. Actual launch focus describe services and collect inquiries. Phone forms single column. English review.
